| **Summary** | No AI/generative-AI policy could be located for the journal itself or its current publisher. Publisher history matters here: the journal moved from De Gruyter (issues 1999-2018) to Duncker & Humblot (all volumes after 2018, including current 2026 volumes). De Gruyter does publish a general AI policy (degruyterbrill.com/publishing/for-authors/author-policies/artificial-intelligence: AI-generated papers not accepted as authored works; AI use must be disclosed if it significantly contributed to the manuscript; AI may not be used to manipulate images/figures/data; peer review responsibility rests exclusively with humans), but since D&H is the CURRENT publisher governing 2026 submissions, that De Gruyter policy is stale/inapplicable and was deliberately NOT used to fill this field. Duncker & Humblot's general author-guidance page (duncker-humblot.de/services-fuer-autoren-und-herausgeber/hinweise-zur-manuskripterstellung) returned HTTP 403 on fetch, and the journal's own OJS 'about/submissions' and homepage (ojs.duncker-humblot.de/ojs/index.php/hgjb) contain no mention of AI at all. |

**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** The Hegel-Jahrbuch functions as the official yearbook/proceedings of the International Hegel Society (founded 1953), documenting papers from the biennial International Hegel Congress. It is thematically organized around a rotating congress topic rather than open general submissions on any Hegel topic.

**Methods noted as welcome (WO2, qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** Textual/systematic philosophical interpretation of Hegel, Historical-philosophical/contextual studies, Comparative studies (e.g. Hegel and Kant), Congress-paper format contributions (originally presented as ~20-minute conference talks in German, English, or French)

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** *(pending — see "Current positioning" and "Framing requirement" note below)*
- **Framing requirement noted by WO2 research:** Contributions should engage the volume's designated congress theme. Recent/current thematic volumes: 2022 'Hegel und Freiheit, Band 2' (Hegel and Freedom); 2023 'Geist der Kunst und Kultur' (Spirit of Art and Culture, in progress); 2024 'Die Idee des Guten und die Sittlichkeit in Hegels Philosophie' (The Idea of the Good and Ethical Life in Hegel's Philosophy, in progress). The 36th International Hegel Congress (Rome, Sept 2026) solicited congress papers (deadline Dec 15, 2025) with planned later publication in Hegel-Jahrbuch.
